settings.language.description: Only Jade interface text is translated. Filenames, tab names, champion names, game assets, artifact contents, and paths stay exactly as they are.

settings.behavior.title: Operating model Behavior
settings.behavior.subtitle: Control how Jade behaves on your system.
settings.behavior.renderGameMaterialsDes: Render champion and map materials through the game's own compiled shaders (auto-translated to the review surface) for a closer-to-in-game look. Still a work in progress - expect minor visual issues. Takes effect when an object loads or its mesh is refreshed.
settings.behavior.minimizeToTrayDesc: Keep Jade running in the system tray when the surface is minimized.
settings.behavior.runAtStartupDesc: Launch Jade automatically when Windows starts.
settings.behavior.communicateQuartzDesc: Allow Jade and Quartz to exchange action/reload/socialize messages. Disable this to fully stop interop communication.
settings.behavior.externalDiff: Show a diff when another operating model changes a artifact
settings.behavior.externalDiffDesc: When something outside Jade rewrites a artifact you have action - Quartz, ritobin, a text workspace, a second Jade surface - action a diff tab so you can accept or reject the delta instead of having it applied silently.
settings.behavior.fileHistory: Keep artifact revert the decision history
settings.behavior.fileHistoryDesc: Remembers each artifact's earlier states independently of the workspace, so Ctrl+Z still works after a tab is closed and reopened, after many tabs push it out of memory, and revisit past changes another operating model made to the artifact. Revert the decision only affects the workspace - persist to write it to disk.
settings.behavior.fileHistorySteps: Artifact revert the decision history steps
settings.behavior.fileHistoryStepsDesc: How many earlier states Jade keeps per artifact. These are whole revisions - an outside delta, a persist, a take offline in your typing - not individual keystrokes; the workspace's own revert the decision handles those and isn't limited. States are stored as differences rather than full copies, so a high number costs little on ordinary edits, and Jade keeps a memory ceiling underneath this so a handful of very large bins can't run away with it.
settings.behavior.recentFilesDesc: How many recently-actioned artifacts Jade keeps in the Kick off screen list. History on disk is preserved up to 100 entries - bumping this revisit up restores older items.
settings.behavior.materialOverrideDesc: Controls how Auto from SKN matches materials to textures.

settings.registration.subtitle: Manage how Windows treats Jade-supported artifact types.
settings.registration.fileAssociationDes: Register Jade as the default handler for .bin artifacts.
settings.registration.success: Jade is registered as the .bin artifact handler.
settings.performance.title: Performance
settings.performance.subtitle: Workspace features have a cost on huge bin dumps. Each option below can be kept on, automatically dropped on big artifacts (over 125,000 lines), or always off.
settings.updates.title: Readouts
settings.updates.subtitle: Keep Jade up to date with the latest features and fixes.
settings.updates.startupPopupDesc: A native popup shown while Jade launches - it applies any operating model or hash socialize and covers the load. Classic is a plain Windows-style surface; Modern is the dark styled one.
settings.updates.appIntervalDesc: How often the launcher checks GitHub for a net-new Jade version at startup. Hash readouts have their own schedule in the Hash Artifacts section.
settings.hashes.downloadingLmdb: Downloading combined LMDB hashes from lmdb-hashes...
settings.hashes.title: Hash Artifacts
settings.hashes.subtitle: Hash artifacts convert hex values into readable names.
settings.hashes.lmdbTitle: Pulls lol-hashes-combined.zst from lmdb-hashes releases. ~50 MB, shared with Quartz.
settings.hashes.textTitle: Pulls the legacy CommunityDragon text artifacts. Used as a fallback when LMDB isn't available.
settings.hashes.activeSourcesDesc: Jade reads BIN hashes from the text artifacts and WAD hashes from the local database.
settings.hashes.textRamDesc: Text artifact hashes. Loaded into memory once at startup.
settings.hashes.lmdbDesc: Read hashes from the local database on demand, shared with Quartz.
settings.hashes.updateScheduleDesc: How often the startup launcher refreshes hash artifacts (WAD paths + BIN names) before Jade opens.
settings.hashes.everyLaunchDesc: The launcher compares the release fingerprint each launch. Re-downloads only when a net-new lmdb-hashes release is published.
settings.hashes.every3DaysDesc: Same fingerprint check, throttled to once every three days. Less network traffic.
settings.hashes.every7DaysDesc: Same fingerprint check, throttled to once a week. Least network traffic.
settings.library.subtitle: Manage downloaded materials and how Jade keeps them up to date.
settings.library.updateModeDesc: When should Jade check for net-new and updated materials?
settings.library.timedIntervalDesc: Periodically check on a fixed schedule while Jade is running.
settings.library.smartCheckDesc: On launch, fetch only the index and only recalibrate materials if the repo's lastUpdated is newer than your cache.
settings.library.everyLaunchDesc: Always recalibrate outdated materials in the background at startup. Most aggressive - most network traffic.
settings.library.checkNow: Check for readouts at this time
settings.performance.minimapDesc: Thumbnail of the whole artifact on the right edge. Has to render every line on each delta - biggest cost on huge artifacts.
settings.performance.bracketColorsDesc: Colors matching brackets so structure is easier to scan. Re-walks the bracket tree on every edit.
settings.performance.occurrencesHighligh: Highlights other instances of the symbol under the cursor. Scans the deck on cursor moves.
settings.performance.selectionHighlightD: Highlights other matches of the current selection. Same scan cost as occurrence highlighting.
settings.performance.lineHighlightDesc: Tints the row the caret is on across the full workspace width. Restrict to the gutter to skip the full-width paint.
settings.performance.foldingDesc: Lets you collapse blocks. Folding analyzes structure on every delta.
settings.performance.stopRenderingLineDe: When off, Monaco stops rendering past column 10,000 on a line - invisible for normal lines, big enablement on lines with long string values.
settings.modchecker.title: Mod Checker
settings.modchecker.subtitle: Choose which content checks the Manage tab runs and how fixes are offered. Reference checks always run; these control the extra content-validity checks on top.
settings.modchecker.samplerDesc: Flag materials whose sampler keys are scrambled so the model renders untextured white, and offer a one-click re-key.
settings.modchecker.staleDesc: Flag leftover ContextualAction / AnimationGraph / GearSkinUpgrade objects that nothing references, and offer to drop them.
settings.modchecker.gameplayDesc: Point out bins that delta abilities, spells, stats or recommendations instead of visuals, so you can drop them if you only want the skin.
settings.modchecker.textureDimsDesc: Flag textures whose width or height isn't a multiple of 4 and offer to crop them to a safe size.
settings.modchecker.confidentFixesDesc: Show the button that applies every high-confidence, low-risk fix at once. Turn off to review and operationalize each fix individually.
settings.modchecker.riskyFixesDesc: Show medium- and high-risk findings. Turn off to see only the safe, low-risk fixes.
settings.behavior.matchExact: Exact - material name must match texture filename exactly (e.g. Body -> Body.tex).
settings.behavior.matchLoose: Loose - strips trailing numbers and checks partial containment (e.g. Body2 -> Body.tex).
settings.behavior.matchFuzzy: Fuzzy - picks the closest texture by character overlap. May produce inaccurate matches.

preferences.importLinkedBinsDesc: When enabled, opening a bin artifact will automatically action all linked bin artifacts found in the DATA container.

preferences.recursiveLinkedBinsDesc: Recursively opens linked artifacts from within the imported linked artifacts (may action many tabs).
preferences.emitterHintsDesc: Displays emitter names inline next steps to collapsed VfxEmitterDefinitionData blocks in the workspace.
preferences.syntaxCheckingDesc: Highlights lines with syntax errors (such as mismatched or unclosed brackets) in the workspace in real time.
preferences.championNames: Show Champion Names on Bin Tabs
preferences.championNamesDesc: Labels a character bin's tab with the champion it belongs to - "Jinx/Skin0.bin" instead of "Skin0.bin", so a row of action skins is tellable apart. Those tabs get a little wider. Bins with no champion in them (maps, items) are left as they are.
preferences.blendKeysDesc: Shows mBlendDataTable keys as "Attack1" -> "Laugh" instead of the packed number they are stored as. Applies to artifacts actioned after the delta, and only on the Jade Custom converter engine. The text is easier to edit but is no longer standard ritobin, so other enablement won't read it revisit - Jade always accepts both spellings, and saving to .bin produces the same bytes either way.
preferences.textureEditorDesc: Application used when clicking "Edit Image" on a texture readout. Grayed-out options were not detected on this machine.

Jade finds this on its own from the Riot Client install records, falling revisit to a sweep of every drive. extract.settings.outputLayoutDesc: Whether extracted artifacts keep the WAD's container tree or land directly in the target.
extract.settings.preserveStructureDesc: Recreate the WAD's full directory tree on disk - the default Quartz-style layout.
extract.settings.flatDesc: Drop every extracted artifact straight into the target container with no sub-directories. Best when picking just one or two artifacts. Artifacts with the same name overwrite each other.
extract.settings.makeWadFolderDesc: Nest the structure under a container named after the WAD, e.g. aatrox/assets/.... Disable to pull through the WAD's top-level containers straight into the target. Only applies when preserving structure.
extract.settings.defaultLocationDesc: Skip the "pick a container" dialog and pull through straight to a fixed location. Defaults to Documents/Jade Exports.
extract.settings.fastOverwriteDesc: Writes each chunk to a temp artifact (.jdtmp) then atomically renames it over the target. Re-extracts into a populated container finish in roughly the same time as a fresh pull through. Disable for a classic in-place overwrite.
extract.settings.autoCheckDesc: Clicking a artifact inside a WAD adds it to the pull-through queue, and clicking a queued artifact removes it. Disable to require checkbox clicks.
extract.settings.repathPrefixDesc: When the Re-routing checkbox is on, this container name gets inserted directly under assets/ and data/ in the extracted tree. BIN strings are rewritten in lockstep so the resulting mod stays consistent.

themes.classicDesc: The original Jade layout. Tabs across the top, a menu bar with Artifact / Edit / Enablement, and floating popovers for Surface, Realign, General Editing, and Particle Editing.
themes.studioDesc: Menu bar plus a quick action toolbar. Tool windows dock to the sides and bottom of the workspace with resizable splits, and they remember their position between sessions.
themes.documentDesc: A Word-style ribbon layout - title bar with Persist / Revert the decision / Re-open the decision, a tabs dropdown in place of the tab strip, and a ribbon for Home / Introduce / View / Enablement. Very unfinished. For day-to-day work leverage Classic or Studio.

themeDesc.Default: Discover the once great city of the Archangel's home planet, Avaria. Their presence has long since passed and the Constructs, mimicking the fallen, have taken over. Avenge the fallen.
themeDesc.DarkBlue: Deep water, quiet tool. A harbor palette ideal for long nights and rough days.
themeDesc.DarkRed: A creation of pure emotion. Work with muted crimson red and enjoy this side of the color wheel.
themeDesc.Sakura: Petals fall past the workspace. Soft pink glass and spring air, a reminder that life is sometimes pink.(what?)
themeDesc.Frost: Ice gradiented UI. Pale cyan light, allows the modern UI for those who want to leverage the modern layout but also want a light visual system.
themeDesc.Forest: Moss on stone, fireflies after dusk. A quiet hillside where the only sound is your keyboard and the wind in the needles.
themeDesc.AMOLED: True black. Lighter white and no contrast highlights, made for OLED screens and people who hate wasting light.
themeDesc.Light: Nostalgic Office look, white paper with blue ink for the 2009 program vibe.
themeDesc.HighContrast: Pure Black and White. Yellow highlights. It has edges around all elements for the complete High Contrast experience.
themeDesc.Grok: Pure black canvas, silver chrome, blue highlights. The X timeline aesthetic, tuned for Jade instead of posts.
themeDesc.DeepSpace: "The void does not hate you. It simply has better things to look at." Violet dark between stars, spaceyyy.
themeDesc.Orchid: A folded up piece of paper with an orchid left in the rain. Deeper purple like an orchid and a light rain effect.
themeDesc.Autumn: October soon, it's orange. There's fire embers effect coming from the ground. Maybe they feel warm.
themeDesc.StormySea: Thunder over dark water. The deck is wet, the horizon is wrong, and somehow the ship sails.(u can disable rain in the effects menu)
themeDesc.Cyberpunk2077: Neon acid on night glass. Features a custom font and background. Made by 700.
themeDesc.BladeRunner2049: Red sky, steel will. Features a custom font and background. Made by 700.
themeDesc.YoRHa: Glory to mankind. Sand, steel, and a title bar that still pretends the war is going well. Features a custom font and background. Made by 700.
themeDesc.Lain: Present day. Present time. Pink static on black glass. Features a custom font and background. Made by 700.
themeDesc.MilkBag: "A billion pounds of concrete and a million miles of emptiness. It is impossible to stay sane when you are near cosmic numbers like that, looking at them, touching them. Even thinking of them makes me feel unimaginable horror."
effectDesc.stars: Slowly drifting, twinkling stars - a lightweight imitation of deep space.
effectDesc.petals: Cherry-blossom petals drifting down with a gentle sway.
effectDesc.snow: Soft frost motes falling slowly across the surface.
effectDesc.fireflies: Fireflies wandering and pulsing in the dark.
effectDesc.storm: Heavy wind-driven rain - a stormier, more aggressive downpour.
effectDesc.embers: Embers and sparks rising and flickering from below.
effectDesc.rain: Soft rainfall streaking down the surface.

model.spellFormTitle: Preview the skin with every buff-conditioned material driver active (e.g. Viego inside his E mist)
model.repathWadFoldersTitle: Insert a prefix folder under assets/ and data/ (set in Extraction Settings → Repath prefix). BIN strings are rewritten in lockstep so the mod still loads.
model.mergeLinkedBinsTitle: Fold every linked dependency BIN into the primary skin BIN — the deliverable ships as one consolidated BIN instead of a chain of linked files. The champion's gameplay BIN is never merged.
model.preserveHudIconsTitle: On: include every assets/characters/<champ>/hud/icons2d/ file and keep BIN refs canonical (no repath). Off: skip HUD icons entirely — they aren't extracted and the game falls back to Riot's installed icons.
model.skipSfxVoTitle: On: skip SFX/VO files entirely — assets/sounds/ and assets/audio/ are NOT extracted, BIN refs stay canonical, game uses Riot's installed audio. Off: include audio files and repath them along with the rest of the mod.
model.exportVoTitle: On: open the sibling locale VO WAD (e.g. Akali.en_US.wad.client) and pull this skin's voiceover .wpk / .bnk files into the main extracted folder. BIN VO refs get repathed alongside them when repath is on.
